title: EU Climate & Energy Daily Briefing
subtitle: Monday, 2 November 2026 — Key developments from the last 24 hours

highlights.headline: Germany's search for a nuclear waste site
highlights.summary: Finland has become the first country with a final storage facility for nuclear waste. Germany is still searching for a site, while some countries have yet to start. Costs are expected to total many billions of euros.

items.title: Bolivia declares emergency as El Nino intensifies, threatens severe weather
items.description: President Rodrigo Paz warned of severe droughts and flooding as El Nino intensifies, with at least 78,000 families already affected by drought.

items.title: Russia's giant new radar in Kaliningrad raises alarm in NATO
items.description: Russia is nearing completion of what experts think is a giant radar complex in Kaliningrad, capable of monitoring much of Europe. Experts warn the project could intensify the military standoff between Moscow and NATO.
